I am Kendrick Lamar.

==Series summary==
The NBA announced the Finals schedule on January 20, 2026.<ref name="schedule"/> The league rearranged the series so it avoids going up against the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] night game between the [[United States men's national soccer team|United States]] and [[Paraguay national football team|Paraguay]] on June 12. No Sunday game was scheduled for the first time since [[1970 NBA Finals|1970]].{{Efn|[[1999 NBA Finals|1999]] had no Sunday games played as the series had ended in five games before  a potential Game 6 on Sunday night would be played.}} Game 5 would be played on a Saturday night for the first time since [[2021 NBA Finals|2021]].<ref>{{cite web|first=Jon|last=Lewis|title=NBA adjusts Finals schedule; no Sunday games for first time since 1970|url=https://www.sportsmediawatch.com/2026/01/nba-changes-finals-schedule-no-sunday-games/|website=Sports Media Watch|date=January 20, 2026}}</ref>

For the NBA Finals, home-court advantage went to the team with the better regular season record, and, if needed, ties were broken based on head-to-head record, followed by intra-conference record. As the two best Conference Finals participants in terms of regular season record are from the Western Conference, the Western Conference champion will have the home-court advantage.

'''The General Civil War''' is an ongoing multi-front civil war fought in the '''General Republic''' between the ruling '''General Federation''', the separatist '''Neutral Federation of General''', and the revolutionary '''Communist General Militia'''. The conflict began in late 2024 after political arguments, instability, and militia uprisings caused the collapse of central authority under the ruling '''Netvel Commune'''.

The war has resulted in widespread destruction, major territorial losses, and millions displaced across the republic.

== Background ==

For decades, the '''Netvel Commune''' ruled over the General Republic through centralized authority and military control. However, growing political disagreements, regional tensions, and increasing militia activity weakened the government throughout the early 2020s.

By late 2024, the Netvel Commune had begun losing control over several states as regional militias openly rebelled against the republic. The situation worsened when two major factions, the '''Neutral Federation of General''' and the '''Communist General Militia''', officially broke away from the General Republic and declared war.

== Course of the war ==

=== Neutral Federation breakout ===

The '''Neutral Federation of General''', represented by a green-and-yellow flag, was the first faction to rebel against the republic. The uprising began in the state of '''Memes Channel''', where federation forces launched rapid offensives against General Federation positions.

Initially, the '''General Federation''' heavily guarded the front lines in an attempt to contain the rebellion. However, Neutral Federation forces maneuvered around the '''Gulf''' and launched a major northern flanking attack. The offensive overwhelmed General Federation defenses and crushed several defensive lines.

Within months, the Neutral Federation successfully captured most of the southern territories of the republic.

=== Communist General Militia offensive ===

Soon after the southern offensives, the '''Communist General Militia''', represented by a red communist flag, entered the conflict. Militia forces quickly seized control of the '''State of Media''' and launched coordinated attacks from both the north and south.

The Communist General Militia rapidly captured large amounts of territory while General Federation forces struggled to defend multiple fronts simultaneously.

Learning from earlier defeats against the Neutral Federation, the General Federation withdrew into heavily fortified mountain lines across the northern regions of the republic. Defensive positions were established throughout the mountain ranges in an attempt to halt further advances.

=== Annexation of the Foreign Languages State ===

In early 2025, Communist General Militia forces launched a successful campaign into the southern '''Foreign Languages State'''. After weeks of fighting, the region was annexed by the militia, significantly expanding communist-controlled territory.

The annexation further weakened the General Federation and increased fears that the republic would fully collapse.

=== Stalemate ===

Despite major territorial gains by both rebel factions, the war gradually slowed by mid-2025. The fortified mountain defenses of the General Federation prevented further large-scale breakthroughs, while supply shortages and exhaustion weakened all sides.

Front lines stabilized across the republic, creating an ongoing stalemate between the three factions.

== Factions ==

=== General Federation ===

The '''General Federation''', represented by an orange-and-yellow flag with a green tree, remained loyal to the General Republic and fought to preserve the country against separatist and communist forces.

=== Neutral Federation of General ===

The '''Neutral Federation of General''' was a separatist faction that sought independence from the General Republic. The faction became known for its successful southern offensives and northern flanking maneuvers.

=== Communist General Militia ===

The '''Communist General Militia''' was a revolutionary communist faction that sought to overthrow the republic and establish a workers' state across the General Republic.

== Casualties and impact ==

The war caused massive destruction throughout the General Republic. Hundreds of thousands were believed to have died during the fighting, while millions were displaced from their homes.

Entire cities were damaged or destroyed, and the republic’s economy collapsed as fighting spread across industrial and agricultural regions.

'''The General Civil War''' was a multi-front civil war fought in the General Republic between the [[Neutral Federation of General]], the [[General Federation]], and the [[Communist General Militia]]. The conflict began in 2032 following years of political instability and military uprisings. By 2036, the war had devolved into a prolonged stalemate.

== Background ==

For decades, the General Republic was ruled by the '''Netvel Commune''', which maintained centralized authority through military control and political suppression. Rising tensions between regional governments and ideological movements weakened the republic throughout the late 2020s.

In early 2032, several military units defected from the republic, triggering widespread rebellion across multiple states.

== Course of the war ==

=== Neutral Federation breakout ===

The '''Neutral Federation of General''' declared independence in southern territories during early 2032. Using rapid flanking maneuvers and regional support, the federation captured major ports and industrial centers within months.

=== Communist General Militia offensive ===

Later in 2032, the '''Communist General Militia''' launched coordinated offensives across eastern territories. The militia seized control of multiple cities and established strongholds throughout the State of Medi.

=== Stalemate ===

By 2034, the '''General Federation''' retreated into fortified mountain positions in the central highlands. Continuous fighting between all three factions resulted in trench warfare and a prolonged stalemate.

== Casualties ==

Casualties during the war remain unknown, though estimates place deaths in the hundreds of thousands. Millions were displaced due to famine, urban destruction, and economic collapse.
